integrity: Proof is finite/all-parameter, with separate exact computational tests. External independent validation and historical priority certification have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite uniform labeled trees on complete graphs only; the real-rootedness/strong Rayleigh claim is not asserted for weighted noncomplete graphs or unconditional leaf-neighbor indicators. Historical implicit coverage through general real-rooted forest polynomials cannot be completely excluded.
title: Poisson-binomial leaf-neighbor laws in degree-conditioned random labeled trees
